name: Prathmesh Waghmare
title: AI & Machine Learning Engineer
tagline: Building AI-powered systems for computer vision, satellite imagery, and healthcare — from ISRO research labs to production web apps.
summary: I'm a B.Tech student in Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning with hands-on Research & Development experience at the Space Applications Centre (SAC), ISRO, building deep-learning and computer-vision models — including YOLO, R-CNN, and RNN-based architectures — for real-time object detection and denoising of satellite imagery. I'm proficient in Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and OpenCV, with applied project experience spanning satellite image analysis, healthcare AI, and full-stack web development. I'm the author of six IEEE-indexed research publications — four live on IEEE Xplore and two presented at conference with indexing pending — and I've taken on leadership roles as Vice President of IGNITRA 3.0, Event Management Lead at GDGoC, and General Secretary of the Student Council.
shortBio: AI/ML engineer and researcher specializing in computer vision and remote sensing, currently building satellite-imagery detection systems as a Research Intern at ISRO's Space Applications Centre.
availability: Open to AI/ML Research & SDE Internships

education.institution: Datta Meghe Institute of Higher Education and Research (DMIHER)
